role: One per-workout training load for every screen: HealthWorkoutSummary.userScaledLoad = effectiveLoad against resting/max HR anchors, with the latest Apple Health resting HR (and when it was measured) kept across launches so loads read the same before and after a launch's first HealthKit fetch.
types: WorkoutLoadRestingHR: enum — anchor resolution + cached Apple resting HR
state: mem:WorkoutLoadRestingHR.lastAppleValue (OSAllocatedUnfairLock<(value, at)?>, seeded from UserDefaults at first use)
toplevel: Static lock initialised at first use from the persisted value (stored()).

units.does: Returns effectiveLoad(restingHR:maxHR:) using the resolved anchors (precomputed load if > 0, else TRIMP), capped.

Resolves HeartRateAnchors from the Apple resting HR when one measured within maxAgeDays is known (currentAppleValue: memory, seeded from UserDefaults) else the settings resting HR, plus settings max HR, via the lock-backed settings snapshot.
Keeps a finite positive Apple resting HR value with its measurement date, in memory and in UserDefaults (lastApple.v1), so later launches start from it.
units.entry: Called by TrainingHealthQueries.fetchAppleRestingHR with each value it reads.

branches.effect: false: ignored; true: stored in memory and UserDefaults

units.does: The kept Apple resting HR when it was measured within maxAgeDays (30) of now, else nil (the setting is used then, as trainingHeartRateAnchors does once HealthKit has no value that recent).

branches.cond: a value is kept and is at most maxAgeDays old

units.does: The value and date persisted under lastApple.v1, or nil when absent or malformed; seeds the in-memory lock at first use.

branches.cond: dictionary present with Double value and at
